# Comparator versions on record

<!-- Generated by tools/comparator_table.py from docs/claims.json. Do not edit by hand: change the register, then run `python tools/comparator_table.py`. CI runs it with --check. -->

Which version of each comparator the current claims in `docs/claims.json` were measured against. A version is read from a claim's id, sentence, conditions and hardware, in the comparator's release shape. Superseded, retired and open rows are not counted. A comparator with a newer PyPI release than the newest version here is reported weekly by the public-surface check; that report never edits a claim.

## Claims that name a comparator without a version

These name the comparator in their id, sentence, conditions or hardware, but give no version there in its release shape. A public number carries its comparator's version and date, so each is a row to fix in the register (the version may be in `notes`, which this page does not read).
